verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair axis for a payments SaaS platform, but the evidence shows no such assistant inside Adyen Agentic. The product is infrastructure that lets third-party agents (Gemini, ChatGPT, Copilot) transact, and its MCP server lets users drive Adyen from their own external LLM client. Neither is an in-product assistant that users can delegate tasks to.
